sentences.text: Kulsuma vs Rafi Ahmed Rafi And Ors on 4 April, 2025

Author: Moksha Khajuria Kazmi
Bench: Moksha Khajuria Kazmi

Regular Cause List
 In The High C0Urt 0F Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh

[Wp(C) 2619/2021]
Kulsuma ...Appellant/Petitioner(s)
Through: Mr. J. H. Reshi, Adv.
 Vs.
Rafi Ahmed Rafi And Ors.

Coram:
Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge.
 Order

04.04.2025 By this petition, petitioner herein has alleged non-compliance of the order dated 07.04.2023, passed by this court in WP(C) No. 2619/2023, whereby the petition has been allowed with a direction to the respondents to immediately and forthwith initiate formal process of acquisition of the subject land in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, so as to determine the compensation, if any payable to the petitioner for the land that has come under the public road constructed and macadamized by the respondents.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been further directed that the Executive Engineer R&B Division Qazigund shall take immediate steps to place a formal indent for acquisition of the subject land and ensure that the entire process is followed and a just and fair compensation is disbursed to the petitioner within a period of six months.

Compliance report stands filed by the respondents wherein, at para 12, it is stated that as and when the indent is approved by the Chief Engineer after fulfilling the prerequisite formalities, the same shall be placed before SDM Dooru that is authority concerned along with funds for further disbursement to the land owner.

Learned counsel for the respondents seeks and is granted two weeks last and final opportunity for filing compliance report in consonance with the judgment passed by this court dated 07.04.2023 failing which respondent No. 1-Chief Engineer, R&B PWD Department, Srinagar shall appear in person or through virtual mode on the next date of hearing.
Registry is directed to provide virtual link to the officer if he chooses to appear virtually.

opennyai_summary.decision:
04.04.2025 By this petition, petitioner herein has alleged non-compliance of the order dated 07.04.2023, passed by this court in WP(C) No. 2619/2023, whereby the petition has been allowed with a direction to the respondents to immediately and forthwith initiate formal process of acquisition of the subject land in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, so as to determine the compensation, if any payable to the petitioner for the land that has come under the public road constructed and macadamized by the respondents.
It has been further directed that the Executive Engineer R&B Division Qazigund shall take immediate steps to place a formal indent for acquisition of the subject land and ensure that the entire process is followed and a just and fair compensation is disbursed to the petitioner within a period of six months.
Compliance report stands filed by the respondents wherein, at para 12, it is stated that as and when the indent is approved by the Chief Engineer after fulfilling the prerequisite formalities, the same shall be placed before SDM Dooru that is authority concerned along with funds for further disbursement to the land owner.
Learned counsel for the respondents seeks and is granted two weeks last and final opportunity for filing compliance report in consonance with the judgment passed by this court dated 07.04.2023 failing which respondent No. 1-Chief Engineer, R&B PWD Department, Srinagar shall appear in person or through virtual mode on the next date of hearing.
